# XFINLAB Intelligence API

> Financial intelligence API for developers and AI agents — real market events, FinBERT sentiment, technical/market-structure analysis, SEC/CFTC/FDIC/USDA/CBOE official data, and Monte Carlo stress testing. Every field is traceable to a real computation or an official government/exchange source; nothing is fabricated or interpolated — a field that doesn't apply to a ticker returns null with an explanation, never a guess.

Free tier API keys are issued instantly, no waiting, no credit card. XFINLAB also ships a consumer research product (xfinlab.com) built on the same backend.

## Getting started

- [Get a free API key](https://www.xfinlab.com/intelligence-api.html): instant issuance, no credit card
- [Full API documentation](https://www.xfinlab.com/intelligence-api.html): endpoint reference, quota weights, live try-it console
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.xfinlab.com/api/intelligence/openapi.json)
- [Postman collection](https://api.xfinlab.com/api/intelligence/postman.json)
- [Live API status](https://api.xfinlab.com/api/intelligence/status)
- [Changelog](https://api.xfinlab.com/api/intelligence/changelog)

## SDKs

- [Python SDK](https://github.com/lnanology/Xfinlab/tree/main/sdk/python): `pip install "git+https://github.com/lnanology/Xfinlab.git#subdirectory=sdk/python"`
- [JavaScript/Node SDK](https://github.com/lnanology/Xfinlab/tree/main/sdk/js): `npm install "github:lnanology/Xfinlab#path:sdk/js"`

## MCP server (for Claude and other AI agents)

- Endpoint: `https://api.xfinlab.com/api/mcp` — Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON-RPC 2.0, no session handshake beyond standard MCP `initialize`
- Auth: same `X-API-Key` header as the REST API, same free tier, no separate quota
- Tools: `get_market_events`, `get_sentiment`, `get_technical_analysis`, `get_intelligence_feed`, `get_global_market_map`
- [MCP docs and connection config](https://www.xfinlab.com/intelligence-api.html#mcp)

## Core REST endpoints (v1, `X-API-Key` header)

- GET /intelligence/v1/events — market/company headlines, optional ticker filter
- GET /intelligence/v1/sentiment — FinBERT sentiment across a ticker's recent headlines
- GET /intelligence/v1/debate — multi-agent Bull/Bear/Risk-Manager AI debate (Pro/Enterprise)
- GET /intelligence/v1/intel/latest, /intelligence/v1/intel/{ticker} — AI-clustered intelligence feed
- GET /intelligence/v1/technical/{ticker} — confluence direction/confidence, trend, MACD, market structure
- POST /intelligence/v1/stress-test — Monte Carlo simulation, real historical-return bootstrap
- GET /intelligence/v1/forecast/{ticker} — probabilistic price forecast
- GET /intelligence/v1/regime-signal/{ticker} — current market regime + best-performing composed signal
- GET /intelligence/v1/insider/{ticker} — SEC Form 4 insider trading
- GET /intelligence/v1/short-interest/{ticker} — FINRA equity short interest
- GET /intelligence/v1/fundamentals/{ticker} — SEC XBRL 10-K company facts
- GET /intelligence/v1/vix-term-structure — CBOE VIX9D/VIX/VIX3M/VIX6M term structure
- GET /intelligence/v1/bank-health/{ticker} — FDIC bank health (major US banks)
- GET /intelligence/v1/agriculture/{ticker} — USDA agriculture price series
- GET /intelligence/v1/energy/{ticker} — EIA energy data
- GET /intelligence/v1/exchange/{ticker} — Binance/Coinbase crypto market data
- GET /intelligence/v1/world/market-map, /intelligence/v1/world/regions — cross-region macro + news + sentiment snapshot
- POST /intelligence/v1/webhooks/subscribe, GET/DELETE /intelligence/v1/webhooks — push notifications instead of polling (Pro-tier)

## Pricing

- Free tier: issued instantly at signup, no card required
- Pro tier: self-serve Stripe checkout from [intelligence-api.html](https://www.xfinlab.com/intelligence-api.html)
- [Live pricing/addon status](https://api.xfinlab.com/api/stripe/status)

## Consumer product

- [XFINLAB research platform](https://www.xfinlab.com): the same backend packaged as a consumer investment-research product — AI market analysis, chart analysis, stress testing, portfolio tools
